text: Edge-restoring net held within a brightness/contrast corridor (implicit eye adaptation)
description: One net restores clean edges each frame and keeps global stats (mean luminance, contrast, maybe saturation) inside target bands. Loss: penalise only when the stats leave the corridor, with slow targets, so entering a dark space lights up implicitly over a few seconds. Related: fabric-artwork src/auto-color-grade.ts (mip-averaged luminance stats, 10/90% quantiles).

status.comment: A/B 2026-11-24, 500 its from nice-net, both with net.gate = 1 (runs/gate vs runs/gatecorr, train.corridor = 1.0), evaluate.py 64 x 96 mean L1: all pixels 0.1008 vs 0.0786 (push-pull 0.0763), i.e. -32.2% vs -3.0% against push-pull; holes 0.1639 vs 0.1624. The corridor loss (contrast >= 0.8x truth, luminance within +-0.05) makes the net push contrast and drift away from the frames. Keep train.corridor = 0. A slow-adapting variant (targets not from the current frame) is untested; not worth it before the net adds structure at all.
